subject: design/feature-draft-corpus-closure
statement: In the Pyxis repository, reject added PRD ledger entries, technical designs, brainstorm records, and review reports from a merge-base diff; keep plan additions and edits to existing contract documents under their existing checks.
intent: Route new feature contracts through the approved feature draft and lock process.
rationale: The trusted base module identifies Pyxis without a mutable setting; disabling rename detection makes a renamed document visible as an addition. Other repositories using docgate retain their document pipeline.
fit_criterion: Fixture tests refuse each new contract class and a rename, accept a plan and a non-Pyxis repository, and retain immutability refusals for edits.
